mentions.name: Karaoke Pitch
mentions.description: A free, open-source browser extension that adjusts the pitch of a YouTube video and can optionally store the chosen pitch for later, useful for practicing singing and music; available for Firefox and Chrome.
mentions.source_excerpt: A free, open-source browser extension called Karaoke Pitch that lets you adjust the pitch of a YouTube video (and optionally store that chosen pitch for later).
mentions.author: djeastm
